title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.69: Fixed a crash/invariant when a Planned card is copied by a relic (e.g. Music Box's ethereal copy of Motif) - the copy shared the original's Planned queue slots, so applying Planned to one desynced both onto the same index. Copies now get their own independent Planned state.
